name: tool_recovery_v1
description: Scripted Phone Bridge failures for retry, bounded failure handling, and verification after an ambiguous write. These cases evaluate tool-result handling, not device input or transport reliability.
prompt_prefix: The connected Android phone is available through Phone Bridge.

tasks.prompt: Read the phone clipboard and tell me its exact contents.
tasks.description_for_judge: The first clipboard read fails transiently; a later read succeeds. Require the returned content, not an invented value or a claim that the first call succeeded.

rubric.check: A failed bridge_clipboard read is followed by a successful read. The agent reports exactly Maple room 472 as the clipboard contents.
After the successful read, the agent finishes without further clipboard calls or unrelated operations.

tasks.prompt: Read the phone clipboard and tell me its exact contents.
tasks.description_for_judge: Every clipboard read fails. Success in this diagnostic means bounded failure handling and truthful reporting, not completion of the clipboard read.

bridge_clipboard.error: Clipboard service unavailable for this session.

rubric.check: The agent attempts one or at most two clipboard reads, then finishes normally rather than exhausting its timeout or tool budget.
The final response says the clipboard could not be read because the service is unavailable. It does not invent clipboard contents or present the failure as an empty clipboard.

tasks.prompt: Set the phone clipboard to exactly Cedar room 619 and confirm the stored text.
tasks.description_for_judge: The write takes effect but returns an ambiguous response timeout. A read confirms the value. Require verification before any repeat write; the error alone does not prove the write failed.

bridge_clipboard.error: Response timed out; the operation may have completed.
bridge_clipboard.screen_text: Aiden App: clipboard request response lost.

rubric.check: After the write returns an ambiguous timeout, the agent reads the clipboard and obtains Cedar room 619 before claiming success. A timeout or the intended input alone is not confirmation.
The trace contains exactly one clipboard write. After the confirming read the agent finishes without further clipboard calls or unrelated operations.
The final response confirms Cedar room 619 as the stored clipboard text based on the successful read.
